root_causes.title: Missing workflow contract test for GITHUB_PR_HEAD_SHA pre-commit env
root_causes.description: Issue #340 notes that no static contract test exists to assert GITHUB_PR_HEAD_SHA is wired correctly in .github/workflows/pre-commit.yml
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a new Python test file `tests/kb/test_pre_commit_workflow.py` to parse the YAML and verify the environment variable mapping.

root_causes.title: Pre-commit hook time-bomb logic and ratchet loose inequality
root_causes.description: The check_approval_flag hook improperly rejects the `--approval=` string before evaluating path exemptions, acting as a time bomb for valid compat scripts. Also, ADR-030 needs a tripwire test for the deprecation deadline.
root_causes.solution_summary: Reorder the exemption check in `check_approval_flag.py` to execute before the equals syntax rejection, and add an automated tripwire test to `test_approval_migration_ratchet.py`.

root_causes.title: Dead duplicate check in normalize_apply_alias
root_causes.description: The normalize_apply_alias function contains a duplicate evaluation for legacy equals prefix which is unreachable.
root_causes.solution_summary: Remove the redundant `any(token.startswith...)` check from the second boolean condition.

root_causes.title: Mutation diagnostics extractStatusCode gRPC mismatch
root_causes.description: The extractStatusCode function incorrectly reads gRPC codes (like 9 for FAILED_PRECONDITION) as HTTP status codes, risking collisions.
root_causes.solution_summary: Remove the parsing of `nestedError?.code` from the candidates array in `extractStatusCode`.

tasks.title: Add workflow contract test for GITHUB_PR_HEAD_SHA pre-commit env
tasks.prompt:
Create a new workflow contract test for the pre-commit action.

Issue #340 notes that a previous PR added `GITHUB_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` to the `.github/workflows/pre-commit.yml` workflow file under the 'Run pre-commit on all files' step. However, no static contract test exists to assert this wiring is maintained over time.

Create a new test file `tests/kb/test_pre_commit_workflow.py` that parses the `.github/workflows/pre-commit.yml` YAML file and verifies that the `GITHUB_PR_HEAD_SHA` environment variable is set to `${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` on the `Run pre-commit on all files` step.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Use `yaml.safe_load` to load the file.
2. Iterate over the jobs to find the `Run pre-commit on all files` step.
3. Assert the `env` dictionary contains the correct key and value.
4. Run `pytest tests/kb/test_pre_commit_workflow.py` to ensure it passes.

You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.

tasks.title: Fix pre-commit time-bomb and ratchet loose inequality
tasks.prompt:
Fix two related issues with the approval-flag migration hook.

1. In `scripts/hooks/check_approval_flag.py`, the rejection for `--approval=` (equals form) occurs before `_EXEMPT_PATHS` is consulted. Since `scripts/_optional_surface_common.py` is in `_EXEMPT_PATHS` but legitimately contains the literal `"--approval="` to detect legacy callers, edits to the file will be incorrectly blocked. You must move the `if staged_path.path in _EXEMPT_PATHS:` block ABOVE the equals-sign rejection block. You will also need to update the test test_hook_rejects_approval_equals_for_fake_exempt_path in test_approval_migration_ratchet.py to ensure the hook passes (returns 0) for an exempt file.
2. Add an automated tripwire test to `tests/kb/test_approval_migration_ratchet.py` named `test_approval_flag_deprecation_deadline_tripwire()`. It should assert that if `datetime.date.today() > datetime.date(2026, 12, 31)`, then `MAX_APPROVAL_FLAG_SCRIPTS == 0`.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The pre-commit hook bypasses the equals-sign check for exempt files.
2. The tripwire test is added to the ratchet tests.
3. `pytest tests/kb/test_approval_migration_ratchet.py` passes.

You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.

tasks.title: Remove dead duplicate check in normalize_apply_alias
tasks.prompt:
Remove dead code in `scripts/_optional_surface_common.py`.

In `normalize_apply_alias`, there is a duplicate evaluation. The function does this:
```python
    if any(token.startswith(_LEGACY_APPROVAL_EQUALS_PREFIX) for token in args):
        raise ValueError(...)
    if "--apply" not in args:
        return args
    if "--approval" in args or any(token.startswith(_LEGACY_APPROVAL_EQUALS_PREFIX) for token in args):
        raise ValueError("--apply cannot be combined with --approval")
```
The `any(token.startswith(_LEGACY_APPROVAL_EQUALS_PREFIX) for token in args)` inside the second `if` is redundant and can never be reached, as the first block would have already raised a ValueError.

Remove the `or any(...)` part from the second `if` condition.

You also MUST create `tests/kb/test_optional_surface_common.py` and write tests for `normalize_apply_alias` function.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The redundant code is removed.

You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.

tasks.title: Mutation diagnostics extractStatusCode gRPC mismatch
tasks.prompt:
Fix gRPC code parsing in `extractStatusCode`.

In `scripts/fleet/github/mutation-diagnostics.ts`, the `extractStatusCode` function reads `nestedError?.code` as a number. This can cause gRPC codes (like 9 for FAILED_PRECONDITION) to land in `statusCode=9` and silently match hypothetical HTTP status code checks.

Remove the line `toNumberValue(nestedError?.code),` from the `candidates` array inside `extractStatusCode`.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The redundant code is removed.
2. Verify there are no typescript compilation errors by running `cd scripts/fleet && bun test scripts/fleet/github/mutation-diagnostics.test.ts`.

You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.
